# lean-browser-use

> The process and tools for token-lean browser work: a fresh subagent runner, bulk packets, guards, reusable extraction, and a local transcript meter.

Install: `npx lean-browser-use`

## Docs

- [Installation, flags, health checks, and removal](https://github.com/aunysillyme/lean-browser-use/blob/main/docs/install.md)
- [How routing, packets, verification, and cleanup work](https://github.com/aunysillyme/lean-browser-use/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.md)
- [Guard rules, registration, and payload checks](https://github.com/aunysillyme/lean-browser-use/blob/main/docs/guards.md)
- [How to measure main and runner browser context](https://github.com/aunysillyme/lean-browser-use/blob/main/docs/measure.md)
